svg.aria-label: 3 timelines of 24 cycles. Each group of threads reads for 6 cycles and then adds for 2, and the groups share 1 arithmetic unit; group k starts 2k cycles after group 0. With 1 group the unit is busy 6 of 24 cycles, 2 of every 8. With 2 groups it is busy 10 of 24, 4 of every 8. With 4 groups it is busy 18 of 24: from cycle 6 on, some group always has its values ready, and the unit never waits.
svg.text: A round takes 8 cycles and an add 2, so 8 / 2 = 4 groups fill every cycle.
unit busy 6 of 24 cycles: 2 of every 8 cycles
unit busy 10 of 24 cycles: 4 of every 8 cycles
unit busy 18 of 24 cycles: every cycle from cycle 6 on
